B41586-88(đ)
Attention Central Station customers and MTS riders!
This is a reminder that all next week we'll be operating
under a special schedule. This will include extra trains and
bus routes to accommodate increased passenger traffic.
We anticipate thousands of people will be visiting the city
to celebrate 100 years since Plattville was founded. Trains
may be especially busy in the area around the city center
and the historic district. To ensure that your commute will
not be disrupted, visit our Web site for the most up-to-date
schedule and traffic information. Thank you and enjoy the ride!
